title: Powerball Rules Cut Your Odds To 1 In 292,201,338
hook: Powerball changed its rules and made the jackpot even harder to win.
closing: Bigger jackpots advertise excitement, not better odds, so know the math before buying.
question: Would these odds stop you?

segments.say: Lightning strikes about one person in 15,300 over a lifetime. A Powerball win is vastly less likely.
A lifetime shark attack is about one in 11.5 million. Powerball still makes that look common.
Powerball odds worsened to one in 292,201,338 per play. The rule change manufactured bigger jackpots by creating fewer winners.
